paper_description: Three Paper got accepted: 'Context-aware Telco Outdoor Localization' accepted by IEEE Trans. on Mobile Computing (TMC), 'SST: Synchronized Spatial-Temporal Trajectory Similarity Search' accepted by Springer GeoInformatic, and 'IFLoc: Indoor Height Estimation by Telco Data' by IEEE MDM 2020.

Three Paper got accepted: 'Transfer Learning-Based Outdoor Position Recovery with Cellular Data' accepted by IEEE Trans. on Mobile Computing (TMC), 'A Data-driven Sequential Localization Framework for Big Telco Data' accepted by IEEE Trans. on Knowledge and Data Engineering (TKDE), and 'Accurate Demand Forecasting for Retails with Deep Neural Networks' by EDBT 2020 (short paper).
Our Paper 'DeepLoc: Deep Neural Network-based Telco Outdoor Location Recovery' by Yige Zhang, Yu Xiao, Kai Zhao and Weixiong Rao won the Best Paper Award at MobiQuitous 2019.
Two papers got accepted by ACM CIKM 2019: 1) 'PRNet: Outdoor Position Recovery for Heterogenous Telco Data by Deep Neural Network' and 2) 'Experimental Study of Multivariate Time Series Forecasting'.

One poster paper and one demo paper are accepted by Sensys 2018: Deep Neural Network-based Telco Outdoor Localization (Poster) by Yige Zhang, Weixiong Rao, Yu Xiao, and Frequent Pattern-based Trajectory Completion (Demo) by Zhiqiang. Zhang, Weixiong Rao, Fehmi Ben Abdesslem.
One paper is accepted by ALGOSENSORS 2018: Localization of MR Records with Missing RSSI Information by Jinhua Lv, Qinpei Zhao, Weixiong Rao, Yige Zhang, Mingxuan Yuan, Jia Zeng.
